```{r cars,fig.width=27.5,fig.height=5}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
rm(list = ls())

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(agricolae)
library(patchwork)
library(car)
library(ggtext)
library(FSA)
library(rcompanion)

da <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "Carbon")

da$treatment2 <- factor(da$treatment2, 
                        levels = c("N0-C0", "N50-C0", "N0-C2000", "N50-C2000"),
                        labels = c("Control", "N", "C", "NC"))
da$N <- factor(da$N, levels = c("N0", "N50"))
da$C <- factor(da$C, levels = c("C0", "C2000"))

indicators <- c("pH", "metals", "s_cn", "ARG", "MRG", "ABG")

ylabs <- list(
  s_cn   = "Soil C/N ratio",
  pH     = "Soil pH",
  metals = expression(bold("Heavy metals concentration (mg kg"^{-1}*")")),
  ARG    = "Relative abundance of ARGs (\u00D7/Gb)",
  MRG    = "Relative abundance of MRGs (\u00D7/Gb)",
  ABG    = "Relative abundance of ABGs (\u00D7/Gb)"
)

col11 <- c("#7D7D7D", "#CC4125", "#F5C87A", "#8FD3F4")

check_assumptions <- function(y, trt) {
  df <- data.frame(y = y, trt = trt)
  df <- df[!is.na(df$y), ]
  
  shapiro_p <- tapply(df$y, df$trt, function(x) {
    if (length(x) >= 3 && length(x) <= 5000) shapiro.test(x)$p.value else NA
  })
  
  levene_p <- tryCatch({
    car::leveneTest(y ~ trt, data = df)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  }, error = function(e) NA)
  
  is_normal <- all(shapiro_p > 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  is_equal_var <- !is.na(levene_p) && levene_p > 0.05
  
  return(is_normal & is_equal_var)
}

get_sig_labels <- function(y, trt, use_param) {
  df <- data.frame(y = y, trt = trt)
  df <- df[!is.na(df$y), ]
  
  if (use_param) {
    fit <- aov(y ~ trt, data = df)
    hsd <- agricolae::HSD.test(fit, "trt", console = FALSE)
    res <- hsd$groups
    res$grp <- rownames(res)
    return(data.frame(grp = res$grp, sig_lab = res$groups))
  } else {
    dunn <- FSA::dunnTest(y ~ trt, data = df, method = "bh")
    cld <- rcompanion::cldList(P.adj ~ Comparison, data = dunn$res, threshold = 0.05)
    return(data.frame(grp = cld$Group, sig_lab = cld$Letter))
  }
}

get_stat_text <- function(y, N, C, use_param) {
  df_tmp <- data.frame(y = y, N = N, C = C)
  df_tmp <- df_tmp[!is.na(df_tmp$y), ]
  
  fmt <- function(x) {
    ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", 
           ifelse(x == 0, "< 0.001",
                  ifelse(x < 0.001, sprintf("%.1e", x), sprintf("%.3f", x))))
  }
  
  if (use_param) {
    fit <- aov(y ~ N * C, data = df_tmp)
    s <- as.data.frame(car::Anova(fit, type = "III"))
    
    f1 <- fmt(s["N", "F value"]); p1 <- fmt(s["N", "Pr(>F)"])
    f2 <- fmt(s["C", "F value"]); p2 <- fmt(s["C", "Pr(>F)"])
    f3 <- fmt(s["N:C", "F value"]); p3 <- fmt(s["N:C", "Pr(>F)"])
    
    sprintf(
      "<b>N</b>: <b><i>F</i></b> = <b>%s</b>, <b><i>p</i></b> = <b>%s</b><br><b>C</b>: <b><i>F</i></b> = <b>%s</b>, <b><i>p</i></b> = <b>%s</b>;  <b>N</b>&times;<b>C</b>: <b><i>F</i></b> = <b>%s</b>, <b><i>p</i></b> = <b>%s</b>",
      f1, p1, f2, p2, f3, p3
    )
  } else {
    srh <- rcompanion::scheirerRayHare(y ~ N * C, data = df_tmp, verbose = FALSE)
    
    h1 <- fmt(srh["N", "H"]); p1 <- fmt(srh["N", "p.value"])
    h2 <- fmt(srh["C", "H"]); p2 <- fmt(srh["C", "p.value"])
    h3 <- fmt(srh["N:C", "H"]); p3 <- fmt(srh["N:C", "p.value"])
    
    sprintf(
      "<b>N</b>: <b><i>H</i></b> = <b>%s</b>, <b><i>p</i></b> = <b>%s</b><br><b>C</b>: <b><i>H</i></b> = <b>%s</b>, <b><i>p</i></b> = <b>%s</b>;  <b>N</b>&times;<b>C</b>: <b><i>H</i></b> = <b>%s</b>, <b><i>p</i></b> = <b>%s</b>",
      h1, p1, h2, p2, h3, p3
    )
  }
}

plot_indicator <- function(yvar, df, ylab = yvar) {
  df <- df[!is.na(df[[yvar]]), ]
  
  df$treatment2 <- factor(df$treatment2, levels = c("Control", "N", "C", "NC"))
  df$N <- factor(df$N, levels = c("N0", "N50"))
  df$C <- factor(df$C, levels = c("C0", "C2000"))
  
  use_param <- check_assumptions(df[[yvar]], df$treatment2)
  cat(sprintf("Indicator [%s]: Meets normality and homogeneity assumptions? -> %s (Using %s)\n", 
              yvar, use_param, ifelse(use_param, "Parametric test", "Non-parametric test")))
  
  lab <- get_sig_labels(df[[yvar]], df$treatment2, use_param)
  anova_txt <- get_stat_text(df[[yvar]], df$N, df$C, use_param)
  
  ymin <- min(df[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
  ymax <- max(df[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
  yran <- ymax - ymin
  
  mx <- df %>%
    group_by(treatment2) %>%
    summarise(max_y = max(.data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(max_y = max_y + 0.08 * yran)
  
  lab <- left_join(lab, mx, by = c("grp" = "treatment2"))
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = treatment2, y = .data[[yvar]], fill = treatment2)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = treatment2), width = 0.15,
                size = 5, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = col11) +        
    scale_color_manual(values = col11) +       
    geom_text(data = lab, aes(x = grp, y = max_y, label = sig_lab),
              size = 4, fontface = "bold", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    labs(fill = "Treatment", x = "", y = ylab, title = anova_txt) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_markdown(colour = "black", size = 11, hjust = 0.5,
                                      lineheight = 1.0, margin = margin(b = 6), family = "sans"),
      legend.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid   = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid")
    )
  
  if (yvar == "pH") {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(ymin - 0.05 * yran, ymax + 0.70 * yran),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    )
  }
  p
}

plot_list <- list()

for (iv in indicators) {
  plot_list[[iv]] <- plot_indicator(iv, da, ylab = ylabs[[iv]])
}

combined <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 6) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag        = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold", colour = "black")
  )

print(combined)

ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig3a-f.pdf", combined,
       width = 27.5, height = 5, dpi = 600,
       device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r,fig.width=8,fig.height=6}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# ===== 0. Environment =====
rm(list = ls())
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ===== 1. Load data =====
file  <- "~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig3_data.xlsx"
abund <- read_excel(file, sheet = "C_MRG_abundance")
meta  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "C_group")
anno  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "C_MRG_ID")

# ===== 2. Standardize column names =====
colnames(abund)[1] <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[1]  <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[ncol(meta)] <- "treatment2"
colnames(anno)[1] <- "gene_id"
colnames(anno)[2] <- "MRG"

# ===== 3. Wide-to-long abundance table =====
abund_long <- abund %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id,
               names_to  = "gene_id",
               values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
    gene_id   = sub("^X", "", as.character(gene_id)),
    gene_id   = sub("\\.\\.\\..*$", "", gene_id),
    abundance = as.numeric(abundance),
    abundance = replace_na(abundance, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_id, gene_id) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# ===== 4. Clean annotation and treatment tables =====
meta2 <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, treatment2) %>%
  mutate(sample_id  = as.character(sample_id),
         treatment2 = as.character(treatment2)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

anno2 <- anno %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, MRG) %>%
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id),
         MRG     = as.character(MRG)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MRG), MRG != "") %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ===== 5. Merge =====
df <- abund_long %>%
  left_join(anno2, by = "gene_id") %>%
  left_join(meta2, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  mutate(MRG = replace_na(MRG, "Unclassified"))

df$treatment2 <- factor(df$treatment2,
                        levels = c("N0-C0", "N50-C0",
                                   "N0-C2000", "N50-C2000"))

cat("Original total abundance: ", sum(abund_long$abundance), "\n")
cat("Merged total abundance: ", sum(df$abundance), "\n")
print(table(df$treatment2))

# ===== 6. Sum by MRG type within each sample =====
df_sample_mrg <- df %>%
  group_by(treatment2, sample_id, MRG) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Mean per MRG under each treatment
bar_df <- df_sample_mrg %>%
  group_by(treatment2, MRG) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ===== 7. Select MRGs to keep =====
must_keep <- c("Iron", "Manganese", "Copper")

mrg_rank <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(MRG) %>%
  summarise(mrg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mrg_total))

top10    <- mrg_rank %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% pull(MRG)
keep_mrg <- union(top10, must_keep)

cat("MRGs actually kept:\n")
print(keep_mrg)
cat("Number kept: ", length(keep_mrg), "\n")

# ===== 7.1 Collapse the rest to "Others" =====
bar_df <- bar_df %>%
  mutate(MRG2 = ifelse(MRG %in% keep_mrg, MRG, "Others")) %>%
  group_by(treatment2, MRG2) %>%
  summarise(mean = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(MRG = MRG2)

# ===== 7.2 Define top-down visual order: Top10 by mean descending + Others last =====
mrg_order_top_down <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(MRG) %>%
  summarise(mrg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(MRG != "Others") %>%
  arrange(desc(mrg_total)) %>%
  pull(MRG)

mrg_order_top_down <- c(mrg_order_top_down, "Others")

# Stacked bars are built from bottom to top; set levels directly to top-down order
bar_df$MRG <- factor(bar_df$MRG, levels = mrg_order_top_down)

# ===== 8. Define fixed colors for 21 metals + Unclassified + Others =====
col_all <- c(
  "Aluminium"    = "#4E79A7",
  "Antimony"     = "#F28E2B",
  "Arsenic"      = "#59A14F",
  "Cadmium"      = "#E15759",
  "Chromium"     = "#B07AA1",
  "Cobalt"       = "#9C755F",
  "Copper"       = "#F0A12C",   # orange-yellow
  "Gold"         = "#BAB0AC",
  "Iron"         = "#B02226",   # dark red
  "Lead"         = "#FF9DA7",
  "Magnesium"    = "#A0CBE8",
  "Manganese"    = "#009E73",   # teal green
  "Mercury"      = "#8CD17D",
  "Molybdenum"   = "#F1CE63",
  "Nickel"       = "#D4A6C8",
  "Selenium"     = "#D7B5A6",
  "Silver"       = "#FABFD2",
  "Tellurium"    = "#C9C9C9",
  "Tungsten"     = "#B6992D",
  "Vanadium"     = "#86BCB6",
  "Zinc"         = "#A6A6A6",
  "Unclassified" = "#E8E8E8",
  "Others"       = "#D3D3D3"
)

# Extract colors in top-down order (for legend)
col_use <- col_all[mrg_order_top_down]

# Fallback: if any MRG is not in col_all, fill with gray
missing_col <- setdiff(mrg_order_top_down, names(col_use))
if (length(missing_col) > 0) {
  col_use <- c(col_use,
               setNames(rep("#D3D3D3", length(missing_col)), missing_col))
}

# ===== 9. Plot =====
# Define element symbol mapping
element_symbols <- c(
  "Aluminium" = "Al",
  "Antimony"  = "Sb",
  "Arsenic"   = "As",
  "Cadmium"   = "Cd",
  "Chromium"  = "Cr",
  "Cobalt"    = "Co",
  "Copper"    = "Cu",
  "Gold"      = "Au",
  "Iron"      = "Fe",
  "Lead"      = "Pb",
  "Magnesium" = "Mg",
  "Manganese" = "Mn",
  "Mercury"   = "Hg",
  "Molybdenum"= "Mo",
  "Nickel"    = "Ni",
  "Selenium"  = "Se",
  "Silver"    = "Ag",
  "Tellurium" = "Te",
  "Tungsten"  = "W",
  "Vanadium"  = "V",
  "Zinc"      = "Zn"
)

# Legend label function: add (symbol) if the metal is in the mapping, otherwise return as is
label_with_symbol <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x %in% names(element_symbols),
         paste0(x, " (", element_symbols[x], ")"),
         x)
}

# ---- x-axis labels: Control / N / C / N+C ----
trt_labs <- c(
  "N0-C0"     = "Control",
  "N50-C0"    = "N",
  "N0-C2000"  = "C",
  "N50-C2000" = "N+C"
)

p1 <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = treatment2, y = mean, fill = MRG)) +
  # Bar width consistent with the first code
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack",
           width = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  # Add expand so spacing between treatments is consistent with the first code
  scale_x_discrete(labels = trt_labs, expand = expansion(add = 0.3)) +
  # Legend title consistent with the first code
  labs(x = "", y = "Relative abundance of MRGs (×/Gb)",
       fill = "Metal(loid) class") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_use,
                    breaks = mrg_order_top_down,
                    labels = label_with_symbol) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text          = element_text(size = 12, family = "sans"),
    # Legend font consistent with the first code
    legend.title  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18),
    # y-axis font consistent with the first code
    axis.text.y   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 20, face = "bold"),
    # x-axis font consistent with the first code: horizontally centered
    axis.text.x   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 20, face = "bold",
                                 angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid    = element_blank(),
    panel.border  = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                 linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid")
  )
print(p1)
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig3g.pdf", p1,
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```

```{r,fig.width=8,fig.height=6}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# ===== 0. Environment =====
rm(list = ls())
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)   # for wrapping legend labels

# ===== 1. Load data =====
file  <- "~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig3_data.xlsx"
abund <- read_excel(file, sheet = "C_ARG_abundance")
meta  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "C_group")
anno  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "C_ARG_ID")

# ===== 2. Standardize column names =====
colnames(abund)[1] <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[1]  <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[ncol(meta)] <- "treatment2"
colnames(anno)[1] <- "gene_id"
colnames(anno)[4] <- "ARG"

# ===== 3. Wide-to-long abundance table =====
abund_long <- abund %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id,
               names_to  = "gene_id",
               values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
    gene_id   = sub("^X", "", as.character(gene_id)),
    gene_id   = sub("\\.\\.\\..*$", "", gene_id),
    abundance = as.numeric(abundance),
    abundance = replace_na(abundance, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_id, gene_id) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# ===== 4. Clean annotation and treatment tables =====
meta2 <- meta %>%
  select(sample_id, treatment2) %>%
  mutate(sample_id  = as.character(sample_id),
         treatment2 = as.character(treatment2)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

anno2 <- anno %>%
  select(gene_id, ARG) %>%
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id),
         ARG     = as.character(ARG)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ARG), ARG != "") %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ===== 5. Merge =====
df <- abund_long %>%
  left_join(anno2, by = "gene_id") %>%
  left_join(meta2, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  mutate(ARG = replace_na(ARG, "Unclassified"))

df$treatment2 <- factor(df$treatment2,
                        levels = c("N0-C0", "N50-C0",
                                   "N0-C2000", "N50-C2000"))

cat("Original total abundance: ", sum(abund_long$abundance), "\n")
cat("Merged total abundance: ", sum(df$abundance), "\n")
print(table(df$treatment2))

# ===== 6. Sum by ARG type within each sample =====
df_sample_arg <- df %>%
  group_by(treatment2, sample_id, ARG) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Mean per ARG under each treatment
bar_df <- df_sample_arg %>%
  group_by(treatment2, ARG) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ===== 6.1 Keep only top 4 ARGs by abundance; collapse the rest to "Others" =====
arg_rank <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(ARG) %>%
  summarise(arg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(arg_total))

top4_arg <- arg_rank %>% slice_head(n = 4) %>% pull(ARG)

cat("Top 4 ARG types by abundance:\n")
print(top4_arg)

bar_df <- bar_df %>%
  mutate(ARG2 = ifelse(ARG %in% top4_arg, ARG, "Others")) %>%
  group_by(treatment2, ARG2) %>%
  summarise(mean = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(ARG = ARG2)

# ===== 6.2 Define stacking order: Top4 by mean descending + Others last =====
arg_order_top_down <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(ARG) %>%
  summarise(arg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(ARG != "Others") %>%
  arrange(desc(arg_total)) %>%
  pull(ARG)

arg_order_top_down <- c(arg_order_top_down, "Others")

bar_df$ARG <- factor(bar_df$ARG, levels = arg_order_top_down)

# ===== 7. Color definitions =====
col16 <- c(
  "Multidrug"               = "#D65190",
  "Glycopeptide"            = "#F38B2F",
  "Rifamycin"               = "#F2E851",
  "Tetracycline"            = "#088C00",
  "Fluoroquinolone"         = "#025939",
  "Beta-lactam"             = "#214EA7",
  "Aminoglycoside"          = "#7552A7",
  "Chloramphenicol"         = "#DB6C76",
  "MLS"                     = "#8B511F",
  "Phosphonic acid"         = "#A38277",
  "Elfamycin"               = "#592E13",
  "Isoniazid-like"          = "#6E86A5",
  "Nitroimidazole"          = "#03C08B",
  "Diaminopyrimidine"       = "#DCA0DD",
  "Disinfecting agents and antiseptics" = "#BF7533",
  "Unclassified"            = "#D3D3D3"
)

# Extract colors in stacking order: Top4 from col16, Others in gray
col_use <- c()
for (arg in arg_order_top_down) {
  if (arg == "Others") {
    col_use[arg] <- "#D3D3D3"
  } else if (arg %in% names(col16)) {
    col_use[arg] <- col16[arg]
  } else {
    col_use[arg] <- "#D3D3D3"  # fallback
  }
}

# ===== 8. Plot =====
# ---- x-axis labels: Control / N / C / N+C ----
trt_labs <- c(
  "N0-C0"     = "Control",
  "N50-C0"    = "N",
  "N0-C2000"  = "C",
  "N50-C2000" = "N+C"
)

p1 <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = treatment2, y = mean, fill = ARG)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack",
           width = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = trt_labs, expand = expansion(add = 0.3)) +
  # Legend title set to Drug class
  labs(x = "", y = "Relative abundance of ARGs (×/Gb)", fill = "Drug class") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = col_use,
    breaks = arg_order_top_down,
    labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 22)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text          = element_text(size = 12, family = "sans"),
    # Legend font consistent with the first code
    legend.title  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18),
    # y-axis font consistent with the first code
    axis.text.y   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),

    # x-axis font consistent with the first code: horizontally centered
    axis.text.x   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 20, face = "bold",
                                 angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid    = element_blank(),
    panel.border  = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                 linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid")
  )
print(p1)

ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig3h.pdf", p1,
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```

```{r,fig.width=8,fig.height=6}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# ===== 0. Environment =====
rm(list = ls())
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ===== 1. Load data =====
file  <- "~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig3_data.xlsx"
abund <- read_excel(file, sheet = "C_ABG_abundance")
meta  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "C_group")
anno  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "C_ABG_ID")

# ===== 2. Standardize column names =====
colnames(abund)[1] <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[1]  <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[ncol(meta)] <- "treatment2"
colnames(anno)[1] <- "gene_id"
colnames(anno)[4] <- "ABG"

# ===== 3. Wide-to-long abundance table =====
abund_long <- abund %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id,
               names_to  = "gene_id",
               values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
    gene_id   = sub("^X", "", as.character(gene_id)),
    gene_id   = sub("\\.\\.\\..*$", "", gene_id),
    abundance = as.numeric(abundance),
    abundance = replace_na(abundance, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_id, gene_id) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# ===== 4. Clean annotation and treatment tables =====
meta2 <- meta %>%
  select(sample_id, treatment2) %>%
  mutate(sample_id  = as.character(sample_id),
         treatment2 = as.character(treatment2)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

anno2 <- anno %>%
  select(gene_id, ABG) %>%
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id),
         ABG     = as.character(ABG)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ABG), ABG != "") %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ===== 5. Merge =====
df <- abund_long %>%
  left_join(anno2, by = "gene_id") %>%
  left_join(meta2, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  mutate(ABG = replace_na(ABG, "Unclassified"))

df$treatment2 <- factor(df$treatment2,
                        levels = c("N0-C0", "N50-C0",
                                   "N0-C2000", "N50-C2000"))

cat("Original total abundance: ", sum(abund_long$abundance), "\n")
cat("Merged total abundance: ", sum(df$abundance), "\n")
print(table(df$treatment2))

# ===== 6. Sum by sample + ABG, then mean by treatment + ABG =====
df_sample_abg <- df %>%
  group_by(treatment2, sample_id, ABG) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

bar_df <- df_sample_abg %>%
  group_by(treatment2, ABG) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# ===== 7. Select ABGs to keep =====
must_keep <- c("Aminoglycosides", "Tetracyclines",
               "Beta-lactams", "Macrolides", "Glycopeptides")

abg_rank <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(ABG) %>%
  summarise(abg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(abg_total))

top10    <- abg_rank %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% pull(ABG)
keep_abg <- union(top10, must_keep)

cat("ABGs actually kept:\n")
print(keep_abg)
cat("Number kept: ", length(keep_abg), "\n")

# ===== 7.1 Collapse the rest to "Others" =====
bar_df <- bar_df %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(ABG2 = ifelse(ABG %in% keep_abg, ABG, "Others")) %>%
  group_by(treatment2, ABG2) %>%
  summarise(mean = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  select(treatment2, ABG = ABG2, mean)

cat("bar_df column names after collapsing:\n")
print(colnames(bar_df))

# ===== 7.2 Define top-down visual order: Top10 + 5 must-keep (by mean descending) + Others last =====
abg_order_top_down <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(ABG) %>%
  summarise(abg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(ABG != "Others") %>%
  arrange(desc(abg_total)) %>%
  pull(ABG)

abg_order_top_down <- c(abg_order_top_down, "Others")

# Stacked bars are built from bottom to top; set levels directly to top-down order
bar_df$ABG <- factor(bar_df$ABG, levels = abg_order_top_down)

# ===== 8. Define fixed colors for all ABG categories =====
col_all <- c(
  # ===== 5 highlighted classes (high saturation, high contrast) =====
  "Aminoglycosides"          = "#D62728",  # bright red
  "Tetracyclines"            = "#1F77B4",  # bright blue
  "Beta-lactams"             = "#2CA02C",  # bright green
  "Macrolides"               = "#FF7F0E",  # bright orange
  "Glycopeptides"            = "#9467BD",  # bright purple
  # ===== Other classes (lower saturation as background) =====
  "Polyketides-Other"        = "#C49A9A",
  "Polyketides-Aromatic"     = "#D9B38C",
  "Polyketides-Polyethers"   = "#E0C68A",
  "Polyketides-Angucyclines" = "#D9D08A",
  "NRPs-Other"               = "#A9C4D9",
  "NRPs-Cyclic Lipopeptides" = "#9DB8CC",
  "NRPs-Linear Peptides"     = "#B8CFE0",
  "NRPs-Depsipeptides"       = "#C9DCE8",
  "Aminocoumarins"           = "#BFA48C",
  "Enediynes"                = "#B9AED1",
  "Lanthipeptides"           = "#9FC4C6",
  "Nucleosides-Other"        = "#BFBFBF",
  "Nucleosides-Purine"       = "#CCCCCC",
  "Nucleosides-Pyrimidine"   = "#D9D9D9",
  "Phenazines"               = "#8C8C8C",
  "Others"                   = "#A6A6A6",
  "Uncharacterized"          = "#DDDDDD",
  "Unclassified"             = "#EEEEEE"
)

# Extract colors in top-down order (for legend)
col_use <- col_all[abg_order_top_down]

# Fallback: if any ABG is not in col_all, fill with gray
missing_col <- setdiff(abg_order_top_down, names(col_use))
if (length(missing_col) > 0) {
  col_use <- c(col_use,
               setNames(rep("#DDDDDD", length(missing_col)), missing_col))
}

# ===== 9. Plot =====
# ---- x-axis labels: Control / N / C / N+C ----
trt_labs <- c(
  "N0-C0"     = "Control",
  "N50-C0"    = "N",
  "N0-C2000"  = "C",
  "N50-C2000" = "N+C"
)

p1 <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = treatment2, y = mean, fill = ABG)) +
  # Bar width set to 0.5, consistent with the second code
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack",
           width = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  # Add expand, consistent with the second code
  scale_x_discrete(labels = trt_labs, expand = expansion(add = 0.3)) +
  # Legend title set to Compound class
  labs(x = "", y = "Relative abundance of ABGs (×/Gb)", fill = "Compound class") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_use,
                    breaks = abg_order_top_down) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text          = element_text(size = 12, family = "sans"),
    # Font sizes refer to the second code
    legend.title  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 20, face = "bold",
                                 angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid    = element_blank(),
    panel.border  = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                 linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid")
  )
print(p1)

ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig3i.pdf", p1,
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```

```{r,fig.width=7,fig.height=7}
rm(list = ls())
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

library(readxl)
library(vegan)
library(ape)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggtext)     # ← 用于渲染 HTML 富文本（粗体 + 斜体）

# ==============================
# 1. Load data
# ==============================
abundance <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "C_MRG_abundance")
group     <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "C_group")

abundance <- as.data.frame(abundance)
rownames(abundance) <- abundance[[1]]
abundance <- abundance[, -1]

abundance[] <- lapply(abundance, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
abundance[is.na(abundance)] <- 0

group <- as.data.frame(group)
rownames(group) <- group[[1]]
group <- group[, -1]

# ==============================
# 2. Match samples
# ==============================
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(group), rownames(abundance))
group     <- group[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
abundance <- abundance[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

group$C <- as.factor(group$C)
group$N <- as.factor(group$N)
group$treatment2 <- as.factor(group$treatment2)

print(table(group$treatment2))
print(table(group$C, group$N))

# ==============================
# 3. Hellinger transformation + Bray-Curtis distance
# ==============================
abundance_hel <- decostand(abundance, method = "hellinger")
dist_bray <- vegdist(abundance_hel, method = "bray")

if (any(is.na(dist_bray))) {
  stop("NA found in distance matrix; please check abundance data.")
}

# ==============================
# 4. adonis2 PERMANOVA
# ==============================
set.seed(315)
adonis_result <- adonis2(
  dist_bray ~ C + N + C:N,
  data = group,
  permutations = 9999,
  by = "terms"
)

print(adonis_result)

# ==============================================================================
# Build HTML labels:
#   - term letters (C, N, N×C): bold upright
#   - R: bold italic; superscript 2: bold upright (²)
#   - p: bold italic lowercase
#   - numbers: bold
# ==============================================================================
adonis_annotate <- adonis_result %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  filter(!term %in% c("Residual", "Total")) %>%
  mutate(
    term = dplyr::case_match(term,
                             "C"   ~ "C",
                             "N"   ~ "N",
                             "C:N" ~ "N&times;C",
                             .default = term),
    p_formatted = ifelse(
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.001,
      format(`Pr(>F)`, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3),
      round(`Pr(>F)`, 3)
    ),
    # HTML label: whole label bold; R and p italic; ² upright
    label = paste0(
      "<b>", term, ": ",
      "<i>R</i>² = ", round(R2, 3),
      ", <i>p</i> = ", p_formatted,
      "</b>"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = c("N", "C", "N&times;C"))) %>%
  arrange(term)

# ---- Two lines: first line N and C, second line N×C ----
#      Prefix "ARGs: " is bold; element_markdown() uses <br> for line breaks.
adonis_annotate_twolines <- paste0(
  "<b>MRGs: </b>",
  paste(adonis_annotate$label[1:2], collapse = "   "),
  "<br>",
  adonis_annotate$label[3]
)

# ==============================
# 5. PCoA
# ==============================
set.seed(315)
bac.pc <- pcoa(dist_bray)

pc1 <- round(bac.pc$values$Relative_eig[1], 3) * 100
pc2 <- round(bac.pc$values$Relative_eig[2], 3) * 100

envpc <- data.frame(group, bac.pc$vectors)

envpc$C <- factor(envpc$C, levels = c("C0", "C2000"))
envpc$N <- factor(envpc$N, levels = c("N0", "N50"))
envpc$treatment2 <- factor(
  envpc$treatment2,
  levels = c("N0-C0", "N50-C0", "N0-C2000", "N50-C2000")
)

# ==============================
# 6. Plot
# ==============================

col11 <- c(
  "N0-C0"     = "#7D7D7D",
  "N50-C0"    = "#CC4125",
  "N0-C2000"  = "#F5C87A",
  "N50-C2000" = "#8FD3F4"
)

trt_labs <- c(
  "N0-C0"     = "Control",
  "N50-C0"    = "N",
  "N0-C2000"  = "C",
  "N50-C2000" = "N+C"
)

lines <- c("N0" = "dotted", "N50" = "solid")

p1 <- ggplot(
  data = envpc,
  aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2,
      colour = treatment2,
      linetype = N)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 8, shape = 19) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = col11,
    labels = trt_labs,
    name   = "Treatment"
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = lines,
    name   = "N"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = sprintf("PCo1 (%.1f%%)", pc1),
    y = sprintf("PCo2 (%.1f%%)", pc2),
    title = adonis_annotate_twolines   # ← 统计结果放在 title
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      title = "Treatment",
      override.aes = list(shape = 19, linetype = 0, size = 5),
      ncol = 1
    ),
    linetype = guide_legend(
      title = "N",
      override.aes = list(linetype = c("dotted", "solid"),
                          alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 1.3),
      ncol = 1
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18, family = "sans", face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "solid"),
    
    # ===== HTML 渲染：title 现在是统计结果 =====
    plot.title = element_markdown(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 15,
      family = "sans",
      colour = "black",
      lineheight = 1.2,
      margin = margin(t = 0, b = 10)
    ),
    
    legend.position      = c(0.01, 0.01),
    legend.justification = c(0, 0),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.6),
                                        colour = NA),
    legend.key           = element_blank(),
    legend.margin        = margin(2, 4, 2, 4),
    legend.spacing.y     = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    legend.title         = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16,
                                        face = "bold"),
    legend.text          = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16,
                                        face = "bold"),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

print(p1)
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig3j.pdf", p1,
       width = 7, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r,fig.width=7,fig.height=7}
  )
```

```{r,fig.width=7,fig.height=7}
rm(list = ls())
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
library(readxl)
library(vegan)
library(ape)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggtext)     # ← 用于渲染 HTML 富文本（粗体 + 斜体）

# ==============================
# 1. Load data
# ==============================
abundance <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "C_ABG_abundance")
group     <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "C_group")

abundance <- as.data.frame(abundance)
rownames(abundance) <- abundance[[1]]
abundance <- abundance[, -1]

abundance[] <- lapply(abundance, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
abundance[is.na(abundance)] <- 0

group <- as.data.frame(group)
rownames(group) <- group[[1]]
group <- group[, -1]

# ==============================
# 2. Match samples
# ==============================
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(group), rownames(abundance))
group     <- group[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
abundance <- abundance[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

group$C <- as.factor(group$C)
group$N <- as.factor(group$N)
group$treatment2 <- as.factor(group$treatment2)

print(table(group$treatment2))
print(table(group$C, group$N))

# ==============================
# 3. Hellinger transformation + Bray-Curtis distance
# ==============================
abundance_hel <- decostand(abundance, method = "hellinger")
dist_bray <- vegdist(abundance_hel, method = "bray")

if (any(is.na(dist_bray))) {
  stop("NA found in distance matrix; please check abundance data.")
}

# ==============================
# 4. adonis2 PERMANOVA
# ==============================
set.seed(315)
adonis_result <- adonis2(
  dist_bray ~ C + N + C:N,
  data = group,
  permutations = 9999,
  by = "terms"
)

print(adonis_result)

# ==============================================================================
# Build HTML labels:
#   - term letters (C, N, N×C): bold upright
#   - R: bold italic uppercase; superscript 2: bold upright (²)
#   - p: bold italic lowercase
#   - numbers: bold
# ==============================================================================
adonis_annotate <- adonis_result %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  filter(!term %in% c("Residual", "Total")) %>%
  mutate(
    term = dplyr::case_match(term,
                             "C"   ~ "C",
                             "N"   ~ "N",
                             "C:N" ~ "N&times;C",
                             .default = term),
    p_formatted = ifelse(
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.001,
      format(`Pr(>F)`, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3),
      round(`Pr(>F)`, 3)
    ),
    label = paste0(
      "<b>", term, ": ",
      "<i>R</i>² = ", round(R2, 3),
      ", <i>p</i> = ", p_formatted,
      "</b>"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = c("N", "C", "N&times;C"))) %>%
  arrange(term)

# ---- Two lines: first line N and C, second line N×C ----
#      Prefix "ABGs: " is bold; element_markdown() uses <br> for line breaks.
adonis_annotate_twolines <- paste0(
  "<b>ABGs: </b>",
  paste(adonis_annotate$label[1:2], collapse = "   "),
  "<br>",
  adonis_annotate$label[3]
)

# ==============================
# 5. PCoA
# ==============================
set.seed(315)
bac.pc <- pcoa(dist_bray)

pc1 <- round(bac.pc$values$Relative_eig[1], 3) * 100
pc2 <- round(bac.pc$values$Relative_eig[2], 3) * 100

envpc <- data.frame(group, bac.pc$vectors)

envpc$C <- factor(envpc$C, levels = c("C0", "C2000"))
envpc$N <- factor(envpc$N, levels = c("N0", "N50"))
envpc$treatment2 <- factor(
  envpc$treatment2,
  levels = c("N0-C0", "N50-C0", "N0-C2000", "N50-C2000")
)

# ==============================
# 6. Plot
# ==============================

col11 <- c(
  "N0-C0"     = "#7D7D7D",
  "N50-C0"    = "#CC4125",
  "N0-C2000"  = "#F5C87A",
  "N50-C2000" = "#8FD3F4"
)

trt_labs <- c(
  "N0-C0"     = "Control",
  "N50-C0"    = "N",
  "N0-C2000"  = "C",
  "N50-C2000" = "N+C"
)

lines <- c("N0" = "dotted", "N50" = "solid")

p1 <- ggplot(
  data = envpc,
  aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2,
      colour = treatment2,
      linetype = N)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 8, shape = 19) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = col11,
    labels = trt_labs,
    name   = "Treatment"
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = lines,
    name   = "N"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = sprintf("PCo1 (%.1f%%)", pc1),
    y = sprintf("PCo2 (%.1f%%)", pc2),
    subtitle = adonis_annotate_twolines
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      title = "Treatment",
      override.aes = list(shape = 19, linetype = 0, size = 5),
      ncol = 1
    ),
    linetype = guide_legend(
      title = "N",
      override.aes = list(linetype = c("dotted", "solid"),
                          alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 1.3),
      ncol = 1
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18, family = "sans", face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "solid"),
    
    # ===== HTML 渲染：粗体 + 斜体 + 上标 =====
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 15,
      family = "sans",
      colour = "black",
      lineheight = 1.2,
      margin = margin(t = 0, b = 10)
    ),
    
    legend.position      = c(0.01, 0.01),
    legend.justification = c(0, 0),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.6),
                                        colour = NA),
    legend.key           = element_blank(),
    legend.margin        = margin(2, 4, 2, 4),
    legend.spacing.y     = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    legend.title         = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16,
                                        face = "bold"),
    legend.text          = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16,
                                        face = "bold"),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

print(p1)
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig3l.pdf", p1,
       width = 7, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r,fig.width=11,fig.height=5}
rm(list = ls())
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggtext)     # ← 用于渲染 HTML 富文本（粗体 + 斜体 + 希腊字母）

# ==============================
# 1. Load data
# ==============================
dat <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "Carbon") %>% as.data.frame()

str(dat)

dat$treatment2 <- factor(dat$treatment2,
                         levels = c("N0-C0", "N50-C0",
                                    "N0-C2000", "N50-C2000"))

# ==============================
# 2. Data preparation
# ==============================
dat$ARG <- as.numeric(as.character(dat$ARG))
dat$MRG <- as.numeric(as.character(dat$MRG))
dat$ABG <- as.numeric(as.character(dat$ABG))

dat <- dat[complete.cases(dat[, c("ARG", "MRG", "ABG")]), ]
dat <- dat[dat$ARG > 0 & dat$MRG > 0 & dat$ABG > 0, ]

cat("Number of samples used for analysis: ", nrow(dat), "\n")
print(table(dat$treatment2))

# ==============================
# 3. Distribution check
# ==============================
#par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
#hist(dat$ARG, main = "ARG"); hist(dat$MRG, main = "MRG"); hist(dat$ABG, main = "ABG")
#par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ==============================
# 4. Simple correlation (Spearman)
# ==============================
sc_ARG_MRG <- cor.test(dat$ARG, dat$MRG, method = "spearman")
sc_ARG_ABG <- cor.test(dat$ARG, dat$ABG, method = "spearman")

cat(sprintf("ARG-MRG (simple): rho = %.3f, p = %.4g\n",
            sc_ARG_MRG$estimate, sc_ARG_MRG$p.value))
cat(sprintf("ARG-ABG (simple): rho = %.3f, p = %.4g\n",
            sc_ARG_ABG$estimate, sc_ARG_ABG$p.value))

# ==============================
# 5. Colors and legend labels
# ==============================
col11 <- c("#7D7D7D", "#CC4125", "#F5C87A", "#8FD3F4")
names(col11) <- c("N0-C0", "N50-C0", "N0-C2000", "N50-C2000")

trt_labs <- c(
  "N0-C0"     = "Control",
  "N50-C0"    = "N",
  "N0-C2000"  = "C",
  "N50-C2000" = "N+C"
)

# ==============================
# 6. Utility functions
# ==============================
sig_mark <- function(P) {
  ifelse(P < 0.001, "***",
         ifelse(P < 0.01, "**",
                ifelse(P < 0.05, "*", "ns")))
}

# Format p value
format_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.001,
         sprintf("%.1e", p),   # scientific notation, 1 decimal place
         sprintf("%.3f", p))   # regular number, 3 decimal places
}

make_plot <- function(df, xvar, yvar, panel_title, xlab, ylab,
                      rho, P, prefix) {
  # HTML label:
  #   - rho: lower-case Greek letter, bold italic  -> <i>&rho;</i>
  #   - p  : lower-case, bold italic               -> <i>p</i>
  #   - numbers and punctuation: bold upright
  #   - whole label wrapped in <b>...</b>
  lab <- sprintf(
    "<b>%s: <i>&rho;</i> = %.2f, <i>p</i> = %s %s</b>",
    prefix, rho, format_p(P), sig_mark(P)
  )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]],
                 color = treatment2)) +
    geom_point(shape = 19, size = 7, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1),
                method = "lm", se = TRUE,
                color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = col11,
      labels = trt_labs,
      name   = "Treatment"
    ) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab,
         title = panel_title,
         subtitle = lab) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold",
                                   hjust = 0.5,
                                   margin = margin(t = 5, b = 4)),
      # ===== HTML 渲染：粗体 + 斜体 + 希腊字母 =====
      plot.subtitle = element_markdown(size = 12,
                                       hjust = 0.5,
                                       colour = "black",
                                       margin = margin(t = 0, b = 10)),
      axis.text    = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      axis.title   = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 14),
      panel.grid   = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1),
      plot.margin  = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
    )
}

# ==============================
# 7. Plot 1: ARG vs MRG
# ==============================
p_MRG <- make_plot(
  df = dat,
  xvar = "MRG", yvar = "ARG",
  panel_title = "ARGs vs MRGs",
  xlab = "Relative abundance of MRGs (\u00d7/Gb)",
  ylab = "Relative abundance of ARGs (\u00d7/Gb)",
  rho = sc_ARG_MRG$estimate, P = sc_ARG_MRG$p.value,
  prefix = "Spearman"
)

# ==============================
# 8. Plot 2: ARG vs ABG
# ==============================
p_ABG <- make_plot(
  df = dat,
  xvar = "ABG", yvar = "ARG",
  panel_title = "ARGs vs ABGs",
  xlab = "Relative abundance of ABGs (\u00d7/Gb)",
  ylab = "Relative abundance of ARGs (\u00d7/Gb)",
  rho = sc_ARG_ABG$estimate, P = sc_ARG_ABG$p.value,
  prefix = "Spearman"
)

# ==============================
# 9. Combine plots + shared legend
# ==============================
combined <- p_MRG + p_ABG +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(combined)

# ==============================
# 10. Save combined figure
# ==============================
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig3mn.pdf", combined,
       width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 600,
       device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r,fig.width=18,fig.height=5}
rm(list=ls())
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggtext)

# ====================== 1. Read data + robust cleaning ======================
plot_data <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "ARG_ABG")
plot_data[is.na(plot_data)] <- ""

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    Subgroup = str_squish(Subgroup),
    group1 = str_squish(group1),
    group2 = str_squish(group2),
    Subgroup_short = case_when(
      str_detect(Subgroup, "unadded") ~ "unadded",
      str_detect(Subgroup, "added") ~ "added"
    )
  )

# ====================== 2. Build combined X-axis variable ======================
plot_data$x_cat <- paste(plot_data$Subgroup_short, plot_data$group2, sep = "|")
x_levels <- c("unadded|ARG", "unadded|ABG", "added|ARG", "added|ABG")
plot_data$x_cat <- factor(plot_data$x_cat, levels = x_levels)

# ====================== 3. Facet grouping settings ======================
facet_order <- c("Total", "Tetracyclines", "Glycopepeptides", "MLS", "Aminoglycosides", "Beta_lactams")
plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(group1 %in% facet_order)
plot_data$group1 <- factor(plot_data$group1, levels = facet_order)

# ====================== 4. Significance labels + p-value formatting ======================
plot_data$significant <- ifelse(plot_data$pval < 0.05, "Significant", "Non-significant")

# FIX: </b> moved AFTER the number so that "p", "=", and digits are all bold.
#      "p" is additionally italic; "=" and digits stay upright.
plot_data$p_label <- ifelse(
  plot_data$pval < 0.05,
  sprintf("<b><i>p</i>=%s</b>", formatC(plot_data$pval, format = "e", digits = 1)),
  sprintf("<b><i>p</i>=%.3f</b>", plot_data$pval)
)

# ====================== 5. Red/blue background block data ======================
bg_data <- expand.grid(
  group1 = facet_order,
  side = c("Red", "Blue")
) %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = ifelse(side == "Red", 0.5, 2.5),
    xmax = ifelse(side == "Red", 2.5, 4.5),
    carbon_group = ifelse(side == "Red", "Labile carbon unadded", "Labile carbon added"),
    x_center = ifelse(side == "Red", 1.5, 3.5),
    display_label = ifelse(side == "Red", "Labile carbon\nunadded", "Labile carbon\nadded")
  )
bg_data$group1 <- factor(bg_data$group1, levels = facet_order)

# ====================== 6. Plotting code ======================
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x_cat, y = estimate)) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ group1, ncol = 6, drop = TRUE) +
  
  geom_rect(data = bg_data,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = carbon_group),
            alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Labile carbon unadded" = "#D55535",
               "Labile carbon added"   = "#2A77AC"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  
  geom_text(data = bg_data,
            aes(x = x_center, y = Inf, label = display_label),
            vjust = 1.2, size = 3.8, fontface = "bold", color = "black",
            lineheight = 0.9,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = estimate + se,
                    ymin = estimate - se),
                width = 0, linewidth = 2.5, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  
  geom_point(aes(shape = significant),
             size = 6, stroke = 1.2, alpha = 0.8, color = "purple", fill = "white") +
  
  geom_richtext(aes(y = estimate + se, label = p_label),
                size = 3.2, vjust = -0.6,
                fill = NA, label.color = NA, label.padding = unit(0, "pt"),
                hjust = 0.5) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.5) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "solid") +
  
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Significant" = 16, "Non-significant" = 21),
                     guide = "none") +
  
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("ARG", "ABG", "ARG", "ABG")) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.18))) +
  
  labs(y = "Effect size of nitrogen addition (log response ratio)",
       x = "",
       title = " ") +
  
  theme_few() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
                               size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1.5),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

p

ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig3o.pdf", plot = p, width = 18, height = 5, dpi = 300,
       device = cairo_pdf)
```
